profile: retrospective GPU fitted timing, no added timing noise
reference: native T1024 K256; paired per-window normalization
selection: For each source/capacity and w=0,.1,...,1, minimize mean paired normalized score on validation only; smallest budget breaks ties.
inference: 50 disjoint test segments per source from two dates; uncertainty is conditional on these dates, not 50 independent days.
baseline_scope: Native V1 and paper-rule adaptations on the same backend; not original full serving systems. Four budgets per family.

adapter_scopes.arrival: Current SPARE, unchanged; no hidden output lengths.
adapter_scopes.native: Modern vLLM 0.9.2 V1; engineering representative, not original SOSP 2023 kernels.
adapter_scopes.sarathi: Decode/partial-prefill/FIFO rule on V1 incremental KV; no original kernels or pipeline.
adapter_scopes.past_future: History-conditional length sampling and future peak admission; shared V1 backend.
adapter_scopes.past_future_multi: 32 draws for batch<16, mean peak gate; declared local choices, not author defaults.
adapter_scopes.orca_max: FIFO iteration scheduling and prompt+visible 2048-output-token reservation; shared chunking, no selective batching.
adapter_scopes.s3_proxy: 10 output buckets, historical median, first-fit packing and reservation doubling; no DistilBERT or swap.
adapter_scopes.ltr_proxy: Historical median score and starvation boost; no OPT/ListMLE predictor or cross-queue swap.
adapter_scopes.apt_serve_kv_rule: Pending/KV density, beta=0 special case; no hidden cache or full phase optimization.
adapter_scopes.sola_rule: Historical risk-ordering approximation with fixed internal cost formula and SLOs.
adapter_scopes.sola_calibrated: Calibrated phase costs, online EMA feedback, phase/budget choices; shared V1 constraints; SLO 5s/200ms.
adapter_scopes.uniboost_static: Phase signal, geometric quantization, fixed gamma and priority victim replacement; recomputation replaces swap.
adapter_scopes.ssjf_oracle: True output length replaces BERT predictor; diagnostic only.
adapter_scopes.trail_oracle: True remaining length and limited preemption; recomputation replaces swap; diagnostic only.
adapter_scopes.mc_sf_oracle: True output length, shortest-first and future KV peak admission; diagnostic only.
adapter_scopes.tie_oracle_proxy: True length supplies log-t mean with fixed sigma; no DeBERTa predictor; diagnostic only.
adapter_scopes.ltr_oracle: True output length supplies score; no OPT/ListMLE or cross-queue swap; diagnostic only.

excluded.srp: Internal ablation, excluded from external comparison at user request.
excluded.TokenFlow: No client consumption/buffer trace or GPU-CPU cache migration model.

fairness: Four budgets per implementation; duplicate paper variants are also reported under their common family.
scope: 13 external paper/system families, 16 external implementations plus SPARE. Oracle diagnostics kept separate from visible-input rule/proxy comparison.
